_note: Registry for /gigs: how each freelance platform is reached, checked 2026-10-30. Re-check terms before changing an access route.

platforms.name: Upwork
platforms.detail: claude.ai Upwork connector (read-only: find_jobs search/get/smart_search) is the source; no write tool is ever called. Without it: official GraphQL API with an approved key (UPWORK_ACCESS_TOKEN), else Brave search leads + manual URL. Upwork pages are never scraped. Proposals: fill only, you click Send.

platforms.name: Freelancer.com / Freelancer.co.id
platforms.detail: Official REST API with your own OAuth token (FREELANCER_OAUTH_TOKEN). Bids: fill only, you click Place Bid.

platforms.name: Workana
platforms.detail: No public API; mostly Spanish/Portuguese projects.

platforms.name: Twine
platforms.detail: No public API; mostly creative work.

platforms.name: Fastwork (ID/TH)
platforms.detail: No public API; mostly seller-listed services.

platforms.name: Kalibrr (gig listings)
platforms.detail: No separate gig board or job-seeker API. Kalibrr freelance/project listings are ordinary Kalibrr postings, already covered for /scrape by jobsites-search (--site kalibrr, query "flutter freelance"); a second skill on the same host would break /apply's host provenance check.

platforms.name: Malt
platforms.detail: Malt registers freelancers only from its listed countries (EU and a few others); outside them it requires a verified registered company. Not open to an Indonesia-based sole freelancer; no public API either.

platforms.name: Sribulancer
platforms.detail: Merged into Sribu.com in June 2023 (design-contest marketplace); no standalone gig board left to search.

platforms.name: Fiverr
platforms.detail: Sellers cannot search buyer requests through any API. Create a Flutter gig profile manually on fiverr.com and let buyers come to you.

vetted_networks.name: Arc.dev
vetted_networks.fit: Global, Asia-friendly; has a junior/mid track. Apply once, then get matched.

vetted_networks.name: Turing
vetted_networks.fit: Global remote; long vetting tests; mostly mid-level and up.

vetted_networks.name: Toptal
vetted_networks.fit: Global, very selective (top 3%); realistic after several years of experience.

vetted_networks.name: Lemon.io
vetted_networks.fit: Historically Europe/LatAm developers with 4+ years; check whether Indonesia is accepted before applying.

vetted_networks.name: Gun.io
vetted_networks.fit: Mostly US-timezone senior contractors; check country eligibility.
